## What changed

Describe the prompt, result, catalog, generator, or repository documentation change.

## Source and rights

- [ ] I created the submitted material or have permission to publish it.
- [ ] Public previews use a stable PagePop CDN URL or an approved repository asset.
- [ ] I removed personal, confidential, private, and internal system information.
- [ ] Attribution and source information are complete where required.

## Generated outputs

- [ ] I updated `data/use-cases.json` rather than manually editing generated prompt sections.
- [ ] I ran `npm run check` successfully.
- [ ] The root README and relevant category README were regenerated and committed.
- [ ] PagePop links include the repository referral UTM parameters.

## Visual review

- [ ] Preview images load and have meaningful alt text.
- [ ] The prompt is readable on GitHub and the PagePop result link opens the intended case.
